entity.summary: Self-custody cryptocurrency wallet ecosystem founded in 2015 and distributed across desktop, mobile, and a Web3 browser extension.
entity.notes: Exodus states it was founded and launched in 2015. Current legal material describes the platform as unhosted and non-custodial with users controlling locally encrypted private keys.

products.summary: Desktop Exodus wallet for macOS, Windows and Linux in the original Exodus software lineage.
products.notes: 2015 is the official Exodus launch year; this batch does not assert an exact first desktop release date.

products.summary: Mobile Exodus wallet for iOS and Android with locally controlled private keys.
products.notes: Exodus first-party investor filings state that the mobile Exodus platform was released in 2019 and available on iOS and Android. The source does not establish a defensible exact release day, so year precision is retained.

products.summary: Self-custody Exodus browser-extension wallet for Chrome and Brave, distinct from the in-app browser feature of Exodus Mobile.
products.notes: Do not confuse Exodus Web3 Wallet browser extension with the separate Web3 browser feature inside Exodus Mobile. Launch date is established by the reviewed August 16, 2022 first-party Exodus browser-extension release event and official Exodus announcement.

events.title: Exodus Mobile Web3 browser became unavailable to newly created wallets
events.description: Exodus made the in-app Web3 browser unavailable for Exodus Mobile wallets created after April 22, 2026 while retaining the feature for eligible older wallets.
events.notes: This affects a feature inside Exodus Mobile and does not mean the separate Exodus Web3 Wallet browser extension was discontinued.

events.title: Exodus Web3 Wallet browser extension released
events.description: Exodus announced the release of its multi-chain browser extension, adding the Web3 Wallet product alongside its existing desktop and mobile applications.

events.title: Exodus Mobile released
events.description: Exodus released the mobile version of its self-custody wallet platform in 2019 for iOS and Android.
events.notes: Year precision only; the reviewed first-party filing does not establish an exact first release day.

evidence.title: About Exodus
evidence.notes: Primary source for the 2015 founding and continuous desktop/mobile software lineage.

evidence.title: Exodus Crypto App Download
evidence.notes: Current first-party download page confirming Desktop, Mobile, and Web3 browser-extension products and supported platforms.

evidence.title: Legal Inquiries
evidence.notes: Primary legal source identifying Exodus Movement, Inc. as a Texas corporation and describing the platform as unhosted/non-custodial with locally controlled private keys.

evidence.title: Web3 browser in Exodus Mobile
evidence.notes: Primary current support source stating that the Mobile Web3 browser is unavailable to wallets created after April 22, 2026 while eligible earlier wallets retain it.

evidence.title: Exodus Announces Release of Browser Extension
evidence.notes: Primary Exodus investor-relations release announcing the multi-chain browser extension and its role alongside mobile and desktop.

evidence.title: Regulation A Offering Statement — Our mobile platform
evidence.notes: First-party Exodus filing states the mobile Exodus Platform was released in 2019 and was available on both iOS and Android.
